answer: Diversity threshold: full rewards only after trading with 20 counterparties per epoch, on a public graph. A sybil vine trades only inside its own cluster, so its partners are all puppets. It wraps one marble column and never reaches the market. Faking diversity costs fees: each outside trade is $5, so 1,000 fakes need 20,000 trades, $100,000 in fees. Honest agents trade broadly, so the check is a light zephyr: one identity, one cost, full share.
